## Commercial Lending at VNB


Whether you're expanding operations, investing in new opportunities, or managing growth, Virginia National Bank offers decades of local business banking expertise. Let our team create a customized financing plan designed to help your business achieve its goals.


**[Our commercial lending experts at VNB](https://www.vnb.com/products/loans/commercial-loans)** , Gina Bayes, Executive Vice President & Chief Banking Officer, and Tim Sims, Senior Vice President & Commercial Lender, discuss commercial lending in our latest podcast and why VNB is set apart from other banks.
